from tinydb import TinyDB, Query, where
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert({'name': 'ana', 'home': {'city': 'Pune'}, 'work': {'city': 'Delhi'}})
db.insert({'name': 'raj', 'home': {'city': 'Delhi'}, 'work': {'city': 'Pune'}})
db.insert({'name': 'top', 'city': 'Pune'})
User = Query()

names = lambda r: sorted(d['name'] for d in r)

# Issue scenario
assert names(db.search(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))) == ['ana']
assert names(db.search(User.work.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))) == ['raj']
# Reverse order + repeat (cache hit returns right result)
assert names(db.search(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))) == ['ana']
# Empty path (root fragment) vs nested
assert names(db.search(User.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))) == ['top']
assert names(db.search(Query().fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))) == ['top']
# where() spelling
assert names(db.search(where('work').fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))) == ['raj']
# Deeper path
db.insert({'name': 'deep', 'a': {'b': {'city': 'Pune'}}})
assert names(db.search(User.a.b.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))) == ['deep']
assert names(db.search(User.a.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))) == []

# Equality / hashing
assert User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) != User.work.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
assert User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) == User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
assert hash(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})) == hash(Query().home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
assert User.fragment({'x': 1}) != User.a.fragment({'x': 1})
# Different fragment documents still differ
assert User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) != User.home.fragment({'city': 'Delhi'})

# Non-cacheable path (map) stays uncacheable and works
q = User.home.map(lambda x: x).fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
assert not q.is_cacheable()
assert names(db.search(q)) == ['ana']

# Composition: & / | with different paths
q1 = User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) | User.work.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
assert names(db.search(q1)) == ['ana', 'raj']
q2 = User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) & User.work.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
assert names(db.search(q2)) == []

# count / contains go through cache too
assert db.count(User.work.fragment({'city': 'Delhi'})) == 1
assert db.count(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Delhi'})) == 1
assert db.get(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Delhi'}))['name'] == 'raj'

print('ALL PROBES PASSED')
